message.content:
Based on my search, Jay Ellis's height is reported differently across sources, but most commonly cited as **6 feet 2½ inches (189 cm)** or **6 feet 3½ inches (191.8 cm)**.

The most frequently referenced height comes from Who's Dated Who and other sources listing him at **6' 2½" (189 cm)**. However, Celeb Heights (cited by one source) lists him at **6 feet 3½ inches (191.8 cm)**. Some sources round this to **6 feet 2 inches** or note "almost 6-feet, 3-inches."

The slight variation may be due to different measurement times or methods, but the consensus range is approximately **6'2" to 6'3½"** (189–192 cm).

Sources:
1. https://www.whosdatedwho.com/dating/jay-ellis
2. https://sfp.mlga.ek.gov.ng/how-tall-is-the-insecure-actor-and-5-facts-about-him.html
3. https://www.bet.com/photo-gallery/xy9a84/jay-ellis-is-in-the-game/gej1ge
4. https://www.mrdustbin.com/us/jay-ellis/
